The '''A-315 plasma cannon''' was a type of personal energy cannon that fired [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] energy bolts and was produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
